blocks: Our participation in the “Paradis Porsche” is under way: the big annual Porsche gathering held every October on the harbour of Saint-Tropez.
The event welcomes enthusiasts, Porsche owners and clubs from all over the world, with hundreds of models on display, track sessions, touring rallies, gala evenings and a closing parade.
Porsche Club Trinacria (with its 130 members), an ambassador of automotive excellence and Sicilian passion, will be there to represent our island at this prestigious international venue.
“Sicily’s passion for Porsche takes flight,” says President Dario Pellerito, adding: “our club will be there with its prestigious cars to bring the warmth and enthusiasm of Trinacria.”
Porsches take over Capo d’Orlando: safety, passion and territory at the heart of the day

More than 60 Porsches brightened the Tyrrhenian seafront for the big Porsche Club Trinacria meet, a day that combined the appeal of engines with the importance of road and maritime safety. The parade crossed the town centre and ended at the Capo d’Orlando Marina, the hub of the whole event.
The day continued with the official conference on safety, with three leading institutional figures:

Massimiliano Fiasconaro, Commander of the Traffic Police of Sant’Agata di Militello
Giuseppe Mendolia, Commander of the Local Maritime Office of Capo d’Orlando
Enza Di Raimondo, Director of the Capo d’Orlando Marina
The meeting was moderated by Dr Annalisa Zappulla.
Castelbuono and lunch with wine tasting at the Santa Anastasia Abbey.

In the heart of Sicily, Porsche Club Trinacria staged an event that blended a passion for sports cars with a love for the Sicilian land: a weekend on 1 and 2 March 2025 that participants will long remember.

The meet started in Palermo, from where participants drove the A19 motorway towards Catania, stopping at the LUKOIL service area for a first get-together. Lunch was at a small local restaurant, giving members the chance to share impressions and their passion for cars.

Late afternoon and evening were all about relaxation at the Esperia Palace Hotel in Zafferana Etnea, where members enjoyed the hotel’s spa and services free of charge. The day ended with an elegant dinner in Acireale at the Acqua del Ferro restaurant, followed by the return to the hotel for the night.

On the second day participants gathered after breakfast and set off for Riposto. The market square hosted a safe-driving course demonstration by the SuperLap professionals, where members could try the thrill of skid drifting.
Lunch was a highlight, held at the Palmento Costanzo winery on the slopes of Etna, where members enjoyed locally produced wines, a testament to the area’s food and wine excellence.
A meet in the centre of Sicily with lunch at Hotel Villa Relais and a tasting of wines from the Navarra winery, kindly offered by our member Totò Navarra.

Charity evening at Villa Malfitano in Palermo.
The evening was organised by PORSCHE CLUB TRINACRIA and the INNER WHEEL Club Palermo, and all proceeds go to the non-profit “ESDRA”, which runs three family homes caring for children and mothers in need.
Gala night at Porsche Club Trinacria: an unforgettable year-end dinner
On 14 December 2024 the Grand Hotel Villa Igea in Palermo hosted the splendid year-end Conviviale of Porsche Club Trinacria, an exclusive event attended with enthusiasm by our members and friends.

A classy welcome
The evening got off to the best start: our guests were welcomed at the main entrance by carefully selected staff.

Aperitif in the Sala Basile
The welcome aperitif was held in the exclusive Sala Basile, where we served a variety of refined starters and a selection of Sicilian sparkling and still wines, creating an atmosphere of conviviality and early celebration.

Dinner in the Belle Époque room
We then moved to the Belle Époque room for dinner. The carefully crafted menu featured four fish courses, expertly paired with Sicilian wines that enhanced the flavours of our land.

Music and dancing
The DJ set added a vibrant touch to the evening, inviting guests to hit the dance floor or simply enjoy the music in a festive, relaxed setting.

Greetings and gifts
In true Christmas spirit, our President Dr Dario Pellerito and the Board personally handed a “Christmas gift” to every member, exchanging warm and heartfelt holiday wishes.

Honoured to have been in Valledolmo for one of the best-attended Porsche Club Trinacria meets ever. Special thanks to the Municipality and to Mayor Angelo Conti for the splendid, kind and impeccable welcome. Thank you Angelo, see you next time!
Taormina (Letojanni), Hotel Antares (4 stars), PATRIA winery with a wine experience.
Cerda, 10 August 2024 – Fashion and Engines: a success for Porsche Club Trinacria

On the afternoon of 10 August 2024, Cerda was the stage for the fourth edition of the “Salotto della Moda”, an event combining the elegance of fashion shows with the appeal of Porsches, organised by the Municipality of Cerda together with Giampaolo Guida.

The event began at 6 pm with enthusiasts gathering at the Caracoli service area in Termini Imerese, on the Palermo–Catania route. From there participants reached Cerda at around 7 pm. The Municipality had reserved a dedicated area for the Porsches, which drew the attention and admiration of everyone present.

Next came a Porsche convoy ride with several planned stops for photos and an aperitif. At 9 pm the fashion show began, with outfits by various designers worn by 25 professional models. Some of the most prestigious Porsches formed the backdrop to the catwalk in an evocative static display on the red carpet, as the models walked between these exceptional cars.

The evening was further enhanced by Carmen Russo, the event’s godmother. During the show, Porsche Club Trinacria members, together with their president, were invited on stage for photos. A special moment was dedicated to the club’s ladies, who received gifts from the organisers.

The evening ended with a buffet reserved for club members, organisers, staff and models, with entertainment music until late at night. Participation was completely free thanks to the organisers’ hospitality.
The event was a great success, filling Cerda, hometown of honorary member Totò Riolo, with the roar of Porsches and giving participants an unforgettable evening of elegance and passion for cars.

The charm of Porsche and the unspoilt beauty of Sicily met in a unique event: the Porsche Club Trinacria meet in Capo d’Orlando. On Sunday 23 June more than 45 cars from the famous German maker filled Piazza Matteotti, offering car enthusiasts and onlookers an unforgettable experience. The cars were on display from 11:30 am to 1 pm, drawing a large crowd and great enthusiasm.

Dario Pellerito, president of Porsche Club Trinacria, said: “Porsche Club Trinacria blends a passion for engines with the culture, scents and flavours of Sicily through a food and wine journey. Seeing more than 45 Porsches gathered in beautiful Capo d’Orlando was a dream come true. Next stop: Mazara del Vallo on 20 and 21 July.”

The meet was not only a celebration of the elegance and power of Porsche, but also a journey through Sicilian and Oriental flavours, scents and culture, thanks also to the “Wagashi” restaurant in Capo d’Orlando and Luca Wu.

Carmelo Galipò, councillor of the Municipality of Capo d’Orlando, said: “We were thrilled and deeply honoured to host the Porsche Club Trinacria meet in Capo d’Orlando. Choosing our town as the setting for this prestigious event could not have been better. Capo d’Orlando, with its natural beauty and unmistakable charm, blended perfectly with the elegance and power of Porsche. Both are irresistible and must be experienced in person. It was a chance to celebrate beauty and passion in all their forms.”
